name: Face-Prime Split of Four Known Peripheral Obstructions
statement: Among the four audited additional obstructions, $\mathcal P_5$ and $\mathcal H_{22}$ are gated-prime and cubical-face-prime, while $\mathcal W_8$ and $\mathcal S_{18}$ have respectively 16 and 1 proper gated two-covers and 7 and 1 cubical face decompositions.
proof: The verifier exhausts all coordinate faces, checks the gate identity, tests every intersecting proper two-cover, and independently enumerates normalized full-cube face-sum descriptors.
